svg.title: Rider CI selection
svg.desc: Pull requests classify their complete base diff. Main pushes classify a cumulative diff from a completed successful ancestor CI run, including Pages. Only safe documentation skips heavy jobs on main. Missing history and non-documentation changes run full CI. Scheduled and manual runs are always full.

g.text: CI selection with a strict required gate
Compare the PR base with the tested merge.
Include old and new paths for renames.
Find completed successful ancestor CI + Pages.
Compare that baseline with this entire head.
Yes: lint, CI Python tests and link checks.
Otherwise: Gym, repo-tooling or full selection.
Yes: fast checks; keep the deployed game.
No / unknown baseline: full CI + Pages.
Only explicitly expected jobs may be skipped. Selected jobs must succeed.
Pending or cancelled code stays in the cumulative diff until validated and deployed.
Scheduled and manual runs always run the full suite.
